description: Source code for verification utilities in the PyTorch ONNX export internal module, including classes and functions for verifying ONNX program outputs and intermediate values.

classes.name: VerificationInfo
classes.description: Dataclass containing verification metrics and histograms for a value in an ONNX program.

classes.name: _VerificationInterpreter
classes.description: Interpreter class for verifying ONNX model accuracy by comparing intermediate values.

methods.name: from_tensors
methods.description: Creates a VerificationInfo object from expected and actual tensors.

methods.name: asdict
methods.description: Converts VerificationInfo object to a dictionary.

methods.name: _compare_tensors
methods.description: Compares two tensors to compute max absolute and relative differences.

methods.name: verify_onnx_program
methods.description: Verifies an ONNX program by comparing its outputs and optionally intermediate values.

methods.name: _create_value_mapping
methods.description: Creates a mapping from value names to values in an ONNX graph.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the ONNX program and populates verification info for each value.

methods.name: run_node
methods.description: Overrides node execution to compare ONNX and expected results, storing verification info.
